scripts.build: npm run typecheck:all && vite build --configLoader runner
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:guard && npm run e2e:development && npm run e2e:production-canvas
scripts.e2e:ci: npm run e2e:guard && cargo build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p audiorouter-control --example e2e_backend --locked && vite build --config vite.browser-acceptance.config.ts --configLoader runner && node scripts/qualify-bundled-assets.mjs && playwright test --config=playwright.ci.config.ts
scripts.e2e:development: cargo build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p audiorouter-control --example e2e_backend --locked && playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:production-canvas: cargo build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p audiorouter-control --example e2e_backend --locked && vite build --config vite.canvas-production.config.ts --configLoader runner && playwright test --config=playwright.production.config.ts
